socfpga_bridge_ll.h

Low-level FPGA bridge interface. Enable and disable requests are sent to the Secure Interface Platform (SiP) with a Secure Monitor Call.

Types
bridge_ll_id_t

Identifiers for the available FPGA-HPS bridge instances.  Note: These values are part of the public ABI and must remain stable.

Values
BRIDGE_LL_ID_HPS2FPGA

Standard HPS-to-FPGA AXI master bridge.

BRIDGE_LL_ID_LWHPS2FPGA

Light-Weight HPS-to-FPGA AXI master bridge.

BRIDGE_LL_ID_FPGA2HPS

FPGA-to-HPS AXI slave bridge.

BRIDGE_LL_ID_FPGA2SDRAM

FPGA-to-SDRAM AXI slave bridge.

BRIDGE_LL_ID_MAX

Sentinel value indicating the end of the ID list.

Constants
Status codes

Values the bridge calls return.

BRIDGE_LL_OP_OK

The call worked.

BRIDGE_LL_OP_EINVAL

The bridge id is not a known bridge.

BRIDGE_LL_OP_EIO

The SiP service did not return success.

bridge_ll_set
int32_t bridge_ll_set(
bridge_ll_id_t 
id,
bool 
enable
)

Issues a Secure Monitor Call (SMC) to toggle the state of an FPGA bridge.

This function triggers the `SIP_SMC_HPS_SET_BRIDGES` command, communicating directly with the secure monitor to enable or disable the specified bridge.  This is the lowest-level control point in the stack.

Parameters
id
bridge_ll_id_t

The bridge identifier (bridge_ll_id_t).

enable
bool

Boolean indicating the desired state (true to enable, false to disable).

Returns

BRIDGE_LL_OP_OK on success; BRIDGE_LL_OP_EINVAL for invalid IDs; BRIDGE_LL_OP_EIO if the SiP service reports a fault.

bridge_ll_name
const char *bridge_ll_name(
bridge_ll_id_t 
id
)

Resolves the hardware bridge identifier into a human-readable string.

Parameters
id
bridge_ll_id_t

The bridge identifier.

Returns

A pointer to a static, NUL-terminated string representing the bridge name.
